Model Polaroids / Digitals and Portfolio Photoshoot in Budapest

standard model polaroids for beginner models and model portfolio building

Model polaroids are the essential first step for anyone starting a professional modeling career. At Aether Art Space, we specialize in creating clean, natural model digitals that meet international agency standards and show your true potential. Our experienced photographers understand exactly what agencies look for and guide you through the process with ease — ensuring your images present you in the best, most authentic way. Whether you’re applying to agencies, refreshing your portfolio, or preparing for castings abroad, we’ll help you make a strong first impression.

What’s included in a model polaroids session?

We create clean, agency-style model digitals that show your face, body proportions, posture, and natural presence. Sessions usually include simple portraits, full-body images, profile shots, and a small set of clean portfolio images if needed.

For new and working models

This session is suitable for new models applying to agencies, actors and performers updating their portfolio, and experienced models who need fresh digitals in Budapest.

What to wear for model digitals?

Bring simple, fitted clothes in neutral colors. A black or white top, jeans, clean shoes, and minimal accessories usually work best. Natural hair and light makeup help agencies see your actual look.

Simple posing guidance included

You do not need to know how to pose. We guide you through relaxed standing, seated, profile, and full-body poses so the final images feel clean, natural, and useful for agencies or casting.

Get a Free PDF face-card with every shoot

This is an industry standard must have. A digital card that you can hand over to clients and agencies, containing 4 photos and your most important measurements.

We’ve created an environment that combines professionalism, comfort, and creativity — so you can focus entirely on expressing yourself and developing your modeling career.

FAQ

Are model polaroids and digitals the same thing?

They are closely related. Model digitals are simple, natural images used by agencies and casting teams. They are often called model polaroids, even though they are now usually shot digitally.

Do I need experience as a model?

No. The session is beginner-friendly. We help with basic posing, angles, and expression so you leave with clean images suitable for agency applications or portfolio updates.

Can I use these photos for agency applications?

Yes. The session is designed to create clean, natural images that show your current look clearly. If an agency has specific requirements, bring them with you and we can follow them.
